maria: :rotating_light: Heads-up to @eng-sre and app owners — we're scheduling a rolling KMS key rotation + disk re-encryption in eu-west-1 on Tue Sep 2 02:00-04:00 UTC (maintenance window). Plan: rotate keys per AZ, trigger re-encrypt, then run a short planned AZ failover + targeted loadtest on a subset of traffic to validate re-encryption performance. Expected: brief token-latency/SLO blips (p99 increase), not full outages. Please ack and confirm service readiness. Maintenance ticket: #MI-4021

ashok: Are Dedicated pools in eu-west going to be drained? What about Private (VPC) customers who use their own KMS?

maria: Dedicated: yes — we'll drain GPU pools in each AZ for rotation, using staggered windows to keep throughput. Private: only customers who use Redwood-managed KMS will be affected; on-prem and customer-KMS unaffected. We'll DM tenant list to SEs.

deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance created: MI-4021 by maria. ETA Tue Sep 2 02:00 UTC. Related runbooks: https://console/internal/runbooks/mi-4021 :calendar:

kevin: KV cache warmup concerns — after AZ failover we often see cold-cache p95 spikes. What's the warmup strategy?

maria: Plan: canary traffic reroute -> pre-warm prefixes -> gradual ramp. Runbook snippet:
```
1) Set routing policy: route 5% traffic -> canary AZ
2) Trigger pre-warm: run warmup job `tools/warmup --prefix=.* --duration=3m`
3) Observe `kvcache.warm_factor` and p99 token latency <= baseline * 1.2
4) If metrics degraded > threshold -> rollback with `routing set backfill 100%`
```

sara: Confirmed — prod-eng will run smoke + model-pin checks on our services. We'll post smoke results in this thread.

ashok: I'll create a burn-rate alert for the SLO and update PagerDuty schedules for the window.

kevin: One more: any SLA credits or comms to tenants? We should prepare a short customer blurb in case they ask.

maria: Good call. We'll draft an email + support script. Expected mitigation: no SLA impact for >5m outages; if extended we'll follow SLA credit process. Draft will be in MI-4021 comments by EOD.

sara: smoke tests done in staging, looks good. Posting quick results: 200/200 OK, p99 token latency +8%.

maria: Thanks. Please ack below once you have ownership actioned. We'll start prep T-24h with final checklist. Post-mortem/retrospective scheduled Wed Sep 3 16:00 UTC.

ashok: ack
kevin: ack
sara: ack
maria: :white_check_mark:
